cage-sacrifice-open.why: In the reference render, the cage door with the padlock and hinges is on the front-left face. Render A shows the open cage door hinged on the front-left post swinging open from that same front-left face, matching the reference orientation.

casket-ornate-open.why: In the reference render, the front of the chest with the lock plate and hanging ring faces front-left, while the curved profile of the lid faces front-right. Render A shows the chest opened with its front latch facing front-left, matching the reference orientation.

rural-tack-trunk-open.why: In the reference render, the front of the chest with the metal latch faces front-left, and the side carrying handle faces front-right. Render A shows the opened chest with the front latch facing front-left and side handle facing front-right, matching the reference orientation.

trunk-travel-open--s1.why: In the reference render, the front of the chest with the latch and two green straps faces front-left, while the side handle faces front-right. Render A shows the open chest with its front face and straps oriented toward the front-left, matching the reference orientation.

trunk-travel-open--s2.why: In the reference render, the front of the chest featuring the keyhole, clasp, and vertical straps faces front-left, while the side handle faces front-right. Render A shows the open chest with its front facing front-left, matching the reference orientation.

floor-trapdoor-open--dressed-stone.why: In the reference render, the trapdoor has its pull ring on the front-left side and hinges along the back-right edge. Render A shows the hatch opened upwards from the front-left along the back-right hinges, with its front face and the ladder opening toward the front-left, matching the reference orientation.

salt-box-open.why: In the reference image, the wall-mounting bracket is at the back-right, the scoop hangs on the right side, and the decorative carved front face points down-left. Render A displays the open container in the identical orientation with its front facing down-left, scoop on the right, and lid hinged at the back-right.

rural-grooming-box.why: In the reference image, the toolbox lid is hinged along the back-right edge and opens backward, leaving the open front side facing down-left, while the handle uprights are on the ends. In render D, the closed toolbox has its front (identified by the green latch clasp and carved motif) facing down-left in the same orientation as the reference.
